channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dean Smith | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dean Smith from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: James Worthy on Michael Jordan, Dean Smith
item.description:
“I mean, Kareem had four years with John Wooden, Michael Jordan and I had three years with Dean Smith, Isiah (Thomas) had some years with Bobby Knight. So you learned the fundamentals,”

James Worthy on Michael Jordan, Dean Smith, May 26, 2022. Source: Audacy.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Dean Smith
item.description:
In giving his answer, Jordan slighted Knicks president and longtime Bulls coach Phil Jackson.

“Dean Smith. Fortunately Dean Smith helped me become the basketball player I am today. Phil was lucky because I was taught the game by Dean Smith,”

Michael Jordan on Dean Smith, Aug 11, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Dean Smith
item.description:
Michael Jordan:

“Dean Smith.[Some audible gasps/murmurs.] Fortunately Dean Smith helped me become the basketball player I am today. Phil was lucky because I was taught the game by Dean Smith.”

Michael Jordan on Dean Smith, Aug 10, 2015. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: George Karl on Dean Smith
item.description:
Karl told USA TODAY Sports.

“The combination of his humility, and just to do the right things and treat people the right way. He was a big meal guy. He liked sharing ideas over a good dinner at a good restaurant, and fortunately I was blessed to have many of those opportunities with him. I’m tearing up a little bit, to be honest with you. That’s Coach Smith right there.”

George Karl on Dean Smith, Mar 27, 2015. Source: For The Win.

item.title: George Karl on Dean Smith
item.description:
“Coach Smith used to get every article on any one of his Carolina players and coaches. Every day. There would be times when I would use the word 'I' in a quote. And he would send me every article with 'I' in it, and circle it. And he'd say, 'don't you mean 'we?' Don't you mean 'the team?'”

George Karl on Dean Smith, Feb 9, 2015. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Dean Smith
item.description:
Mark Medina:Lakers GM Mitch Kupchak on Dean Smith:

“Coach Smith was one of the most influential people in my life, & his passing brings me great sadness”

Mitch Kupchak on Dean Smith, Feb 8, 2015. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Dean Smith
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Rick Carlisle on the passing of Dean Smith:

“It's a sad day, but it's a day to pay tribute to a guy who had a huge impact on our sport.”

Rick Carlisle on Dean Smith, Feb 8, 2015. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.
